name: retro
description: Self-hosted retro gaming stack: RomM, minerva-helper behind gluetun

scripts.build:windows: mkdir -p dist && chmod a+w dist && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/work" amake/innosetup:innosetup6-bookworm@sha256:699b24aacd485f31899daf478e1b84eb06a1f966259bf6def146b46d7d3a3617 windows/retro.iss "/DAppVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')"
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:sh && pnpm lint:ps && pnpm lint:actions && pnpm lint:compose
scripts.lint:sh: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/mnt" koalaman/shellcheck:v0.11.0 scripts/init.sh scripts/check-env-secrets.sh docker/skyscraper/scrape.sh
scripts.lint:ps: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/windows:/w:ro" mcr.microsoft.com/powershell:7.4-alpine-3.20 pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Install-Module PSScriptAnalyzer -RequiredVersion 1.25.0 -Scope CurrentUser -Force; \$r = Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path /w -Recurse -ExcludeRule PSAvoidUsingWriteHost,PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions,PSPossibleIncorrectUsageOfRedirectionOperator,PSReviewUnusedParameter; \$r; exit \$r.Count"
scripts.lint:compose: export DB_PASSWD=ci DB_ROOT_PASSWD=ci ROMM_AUTH_SECRET_KEY=ci; docker compose --env-file .env.example --profile minerva config --quiet && docker compose --env-file .env.example -f compose.yml -f compose.windows.yml config --quiet
